sharedConstraints: Precise edit; preserve each family's silhouette identity, frontal camera and centered scale; marker flat cyan #00ffff, 2–5% canvas, neutral bevel; single icon square1024; no background, floor, checkerboard, opaque specks, halo, text, digits, crown, tower, glass, metal, particles, or extra symbols.
